svg.aria-label: tmux session on tianni, the machine that renders Bill Zhang's GitHub profile. On load the screen power-cycles like a CRT, the ART3M1S BIOS runs its POST, then the tmux session re-attaches. Pane whoami: BILL ZHANG in a dot-matrix font. AI-first builder, hackathon operator, ships fast. /dev/hackathons: 35 won of 58 entered (60%). Now: voice ai projects. Uptime 5y 0m, since 2021-09-21. Moon: last quarter, 53% lit. Stack: TypeScript, Python, React, FastAPI, Postgres. Pane htop: voice-agent --elevenlabs --demo at 97% CPU; skiing --update --demo at 85% CPU; hackathon --review --insights at 75% CPU. Load average: 3 concurrent demos. Sleep: not installed. Pane clock-mode: counts the minutes and seconds since you arrived. Pane journal: Jun 14 passwd: prakhxr0 created an account / Jul 23 fsck: E5 verified by IdkwhatImD0ing / Jul 23 fsck: C3 KERNEL PANIC / Jul 23 mkfs: board #3 online, 10 corrupt / Sep 28 cron[48]: rewrote own bio. / Oct 1 motd: the updates are flowing like snow on a slope. / Oct 1 cron[49]: rewrote own bio. again. / Oct 3 boot: POST re-rendered, seed 2026-W40 / Oct 3 postfix: port 25 open. building something weird? F3. / now tty2: 1 visitor attached. hello, you.
